import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(eps)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2) + (p[3]+p[4]*T**3)*L + (p[5]+p[6]*T)/eps + (p[7]+p[8]*T**3)*eps + p[9]*T**3*L**2
